from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e3f5e007.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid separator lines divide the canvas into repeated panels.
    sep_r = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    sep_c = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    panel = [row[:sep_c] for row in grid[sep_r+1:]]
    bg = max(set(v for row in panel for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in panel))
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r == sep_r or c == sep_c:
                out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
            else:
                out[r][c] = panel[(r if r < sep_r else r-sep_r-1) % len(panel)][(c if c < sep_c else c-sep_c-1) % len(panel[0])]
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(code)
